trust_principles: Detection, qualification, pursuit, decision, work, approval, outcome and learning are distinct records.
Every consequential state transition requires a version-pinned decision and actor.
Models may propose scores, plans, drafts and learning but cannot approve, submit, spend or accept terms.
Workers may execute bounded work but cannot elevate rights, authority, approval or outcome state.
Opportunity records preserve source, evidence, document, language, rights, jurisdiction and temporal lineage.
Unknown, conflicting, stale, revoked or incomplete inputs fail closed or remain explicitly unresolved.
A pursuit cannot open without an approved qualification and pursue decision.
Submission or activation requires current typed approvals and deterministic preflight.
Approval never waives rights, privacy, document currentness, classification or policy.
Outcome state is evidence-backed and cannot be inferred from workflow completion.
Learning is append-only, reviewable and cannot self-modify policy or models.
Portability exports preserve provenance and imports create candidates only.
All audit events are append-only, hash-linked and tenant-scoped.
Canonical or externally consequential actions require explicit human authority.

invariants: Detection is distinct from qualification and pursuit.
Opportunity lineage preserves source, evidence, rights, language and time.
Missing or contradictory qualification data remains explicit.
A score cannot substitute for a recorded qualification decision.
Duplicate candidates are linked and never silently merged.
Rejected opportunities require a new decision before re-entry.
A pursuit references exactly one opportunity version.
Opening a pursuit requires an approved pursue decision.
Membership does not grant approval or submission authority.
Strategy versions are immutable and superseded.
A closed pursuit cannot receive new work or approvals.
Cross-tenant pursuit linkage is prohibited.
Every consequential transition references an immutable decision.
Options, criteria, evidence, unknowns and dissent are preserved.
Model recommendations cannot approve themselves.
Stale or revoked required evidence invalidates future use.
Supersession preserves rationale and actor identity.
One decision never implies separate legal or budget approval.
Work starts only when dependencies are satisfied.
Blocked dependencies cannot be treated as complete.
Completion requires evidence or not-applicable rationale.
Workers cannot approve consequential actions.
Deadlines retain timezone and uncertainty.
Deliverables remain versioned and anchor-linked.
Approvals are typed, scoped, expiring and version-pinned.
Requester and approver separation is enforced.
Approval cannot waive rights, privacy or policy.
Revocation invalidates dependent actions before execution.
Approval reuse outside exact scope is prohibited.
Unknown or conflicting approval state denies action.
Submission is not evidence of winning or realisation.
Outcomes require observed evidence and source time.
Unknown outcome is never coerced to lost.
Forecast, target, award and realised value are distinct.
Corrections create new versions.
Model inference cannot create observed outcomes.
Learning links decisions, work, approvals and outcomes.
Correlation is not represented as causation.
Learning cannot self-modify policy or models.
Exports are rights-aware and secret-free.
Imports create tenant-scoped candidates only.
Bundles preserve audit, provenance and unresolved states.

rules: Unlisted transitions are denied.
Transitions record prior state, next state, decision, actor and reason.
Terminal states require a new opportunity or superseding decision for re-entry.
Revocation blocks future transitions without erasing history.
The lifecycle binds domain-neutrally to AX-LIB-O01 through AX-LIB-O09.
State labels do not imply legal eligibility or commercial probability.
Learning preserves the preceding terminal outcome.
Decision records are immutable and superseded.
APPROVED requires a capable human decider.
Proposer and decider are distinct for consequential decisions.
Evidence and anchors are exact-version references.
Missing evidence never yields APPROVED.
Revoked evidence invalidates future use.
Scores are inputs rather than decisions.
Rationale preserves dissent and unresolved conditions.
READY requires all mandatory dependencies.
Only a human can waive a mandatory dependency.
IN_PROGRESS grants no submit, spend, sign or publish authority.
DONE requires evidence or not-applicable decision.
Invalidated dependencies return work to BLOCKED.
Worker updates are idempotent and bounded.
Cancelled work remains auditable.
Due dates preserve timezone and uncertainty.

separation_of_duties: Requester cannot approve the same consequential request.
Model, browser, connector and worker cannot approve.
Rights and legal approvals use distinct authorities.
Submission approval is distinct from document approval.
Budget approval is distinct from pursue approval.
Break-glass cannot bypass submission, export or rights.
rules: Approval applies only to exact subject, version, purpose and time.
Unknown, expired or revoked approval denies action.
Approval is not inferred from role or precedent.
Rights, privacy and kill switches are re-evaluated after approval.
Revocation invalidates queued actions.
Approval decisions are immutable and auditable.
Submission requires every configured approval.
Approval cannot create evidence authority.
Approval checks are deterministic and fail closed.
UNKNOWN is distinct from LOST.
Submission does not imply WON or REALIZED.
Observed, reported, inferred and forecast values are distinct.
Evidence is current, rights-permitted and version-pinned.
Corrections supersede prior outcomes.
Models cannot establish observed outcomes.
Measurements include method, period, unit and uncertainty.
Closing a pursuit cannot fabricate an external outcome.
Learning separates observation, interpretation, hypothesis and recommendation.
Causal claims require an explicit method.
Unknown outcomes limit learning claims.
Learning cannot mutate prior evidence or decisions.
Model learning remains PROPOSED.
Admission requires human review and traceable evidence.
Learning cannot change policy, prompts, models or permissions.
Contested learning creates no automatic rule.
Aggregation preserves tenant and rights boundaries.
Exports contain no credentials or tokens.
Objects retain schema, authority and lineage.
Restricted content is omitted or referenced.
Hash manifests cover canonical serialization.
Import never mutates the admitted ledger.
Imported approvals and outcomes have no live authority.
Unknown schemas or broken hashes quarantine bundles.
Destination rights are checked before export.
Unresolved and revoked states are preserved.
Round-trip canonical serialization is byte-stable.
Audit precedes acknowledgement of consequential changes.
Events cannot be edited or deleted through product APIs.
Hash-chain discontinuity blocks export and canonical operations.
Actor and server-resolved tenant are mandatory.
Audit stores references rather than secrets.
Retention follows classification and rights.
Rollback creates evidence without erasing events.
Correlation identifiers connect service events.
Client tenant and capability context is never authoritative.
Models and workers cannot perform external consequential actions.
Human authority is typed and non-transferable.
Submission, spend, signature and export require explicit humans.
Canonical writes require independent deterministic validation.
Imported objects never carry live authority.
Revoked inputs contribute zero future authority.
Least-authoritative dependencies bound derived records.
Break-glass cannot bypass rights, export or legal controls.
